corrected_probe.role: choose candidate rational q only; no float participates in the proof

evidence_class: post-hoc finite sensitivity and floating rational-witness discovery; exact admission is separate

initial_probe.cause: q is a common parameter, not a per-class t; upper endpoint was too small when m=2,n=3
initial_probe.record_provenance: Initial JSON was overwritten by corrected script before export; original deterministic probe was rerun offline for this explicitly recomputed record. First stdout had the same failed result. No original timing is recovered.

limits: Adaptive inspected finite law and bounded numerical discovery, not independent trials, LLM outcomes, a general allocation/symmetrization novelty claim or priority verdict. Original C67/C69 and provider results remain immutable.

rational_admission.rule: ceil(decimal string of floating q * scale)+1, then at most10 successive numerators; exact strict combined information<4 and upper-lower<2e-11 required
